program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define frames (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) 4)) (objects g 0)))
    (define (inside-interior? obj p)
      (and (> (fst p) (obj-r1 obj)) (< (fst p) (obj-r2 obj))
           (> (snd p) (obj-c1 obj)) (< (snd p) (obj-c2 obj))))
    (define (frame-fill-cells obj)
      (let* ((inside (filter (lambda (p) (inside-interior? obj p)) (grid-positions g)))
             (marker (first (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (cell-at g (fst p) (snd p)) 0))) inside)))
             (color (cell-at g (fst marker) (snd marker))))
        (map (lambda (p) (list (fst p) (snd p) color))
             (filter (lambda (p) (= (cell-at g (fst p) (snd p)) 0)) inside))))
    (paint-cells g (flatmap frame-fill-cells frames))))
